XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Electric soft top automatic system inactive, tailgate locked
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: ACCESSORIES | FAILURE | OPENING | BOOT | SOFT TOP | ELECTRIC | REAR WINDOW | THERMAL | INACTIVE

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Validity: all

  • System: accessories

  • Device: electric roof

  • Fault: the electric lock on the tailgate does not open, the heated rear window does not work, the electric roof does not open and close automatically (the button must be held down)

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: - -

  • Cause: electric hood needs to be calibrated

• Intervention: manual calibration procedure for the electric roof

  • Procedure:
    (1) switch on the ignition
    (2) press and hold the bonnet control button until it is fully open
    (3) keep the button pressed for another 4/5 seconds while it is opening
    (4) press and hold the button until it is fully closed
    (5) Keep the button pressed for another 4/5 seconds
    (6) Procedure complete

  • Note: - -
